Reference register

Sources and evidence standards

Every statement about Bahamas government initiatives in this portfolio is listed here with its public source, date and status. The register was last reviewed on 11 November 2026. Statuses reflect the source's own wording at the time of review, and initiatives may have moved on since.

Evidence categories

Every major claim in this portfolio belongs to one of four categories.

AVerified experienceVerified professional achievementDrawn from Dr. Franks' CV or approved project documentation.
BPublic sourceVerified Ministry initiativeLinked to a public source in the reference register, with its stated status.
CProposedProposed consulting capabilityWhat could be offered. It is not a description of past work for the Ministry.
DIllustrativeIllustrative concept or demonstrationAn original framework, sample module or diagram. It contains no organizational data.

Ministry and government context BPublic source

Items from mindbahamas.com are labelled "Ministry website". That site presents itself as the Ministry's, but it is not on a .gov.bs domain, and on the review date no .gov.bs page linked to it. Its claims should be confirmed with the Ministry before anyone relies on them.

Reference register of government initiatives
Finding & strategic relevanceSourceDateStatus
The Ministry of Innovation and National Development was created, with Hon. Sebastian Bastian sworn in as Minister and Hon. Wayde Watson as Minister of State.Establishes the Ministry's leadership and its mandate to execute the National Development Plan. ZNS Bahamas: "Bastian Leads Innovation Ministry"National broadcaster 18 May 2026 Confirmed
The Ministry's four pillars are Modernize Government, Build Future Readiness, Develop Bahamian Talent and Drive National Development. It brings together DICT, the Digital Transformation Unit, BNSI and the National Development Plan Secretariat."Develop Bahamian Talent" and "Build Future Readiness" align directly with workforce capability work. ZNS Bahamas: "Innovation and National Development Ministry Created to Prepare the Country for the Future"National broadcaster 18 June 2026 (speech of 15 June 2026) Confirmed
The Minister stated the Government will establish a National AI Literacy Initiative, with online and in-person training to be made available across the public service.Public service AI training is a stated priority, and capability frameworks, pathways and evaluation support it. Bahamas Information Services: "This Government Administration to Prepare Bahamians for Emerging Technologies"Official government (.gov.bs) 16 June 2026 Planned / announced
The National AI Literacy Initiative is described as "currently being developed". Planned topics are AI fundamentals, responsible use, practical applications and digital skills, with government employees among the intended audience.Framework Levels 1–2 map to these topics. Any engagement would complement the initiative, not duplicate it. Ministry website (mindbahamas.com): "National AI Literacy Initiative: What it is and how to get involved"Ministry website (not a .gov.bs domain) 21 June 2026 In progress (as reported)
The site lists a Microsoft 365 rollout (Teams, SharePoint, Copilot, OneDrive) across the public service as "in progress".Rolling out tools creates an immediate need for role-specific adoption training. This could not be confirmed on a .gov.bs source. Ministry website (mindbahamas.com): Progress pageMinistry website (not a .gov.bs domain) Undated (accessed 11 Nov 2026) Reported, not independently confirmed
The Bahamas Future Skills Academy ("a national platform, online and in-person"), a Bahamas AI Skills Initiative and a Smart Government Portal of AI tools for the public service are listed as "planned".These are proposed national learning platforms that would need curriculum, assessment and evaluation design. Ministry website (mindbahamas.com): Progress pageMinistry website (not a .gov.bs domain) Undated (accessed 11 Nov 2026) Planned / announced
The Minister announced plans to establish a National Artificial Intelligence Committee to draft the country's first AI legislation, and plans for a national ID card with privacy and security protections.Responsible-use content would need to align with emerging AI governance and legislation. The Tribune: "Bastian pledges new national ID card to reduce red tape"External reporting 16 June 2026 Planned / announced
The Ministry reported agreements in principle with Estonia and Singapore, with MOUs expected. Topics include digital government, AI governance and public service capacity building.Public service capacity building is named as a cooperation area. Bahamas Trade Info (gov.bs): "Minister signs MOUs with tech-forward nations"Official government (.gov.bs), reposted news 13 July 2026 Proposed / draft
A draft Data Protection Bill, 2025, was described as modernising data protection, including for AI use.Privacy safeguards in training must reflect the current law. Its status should be re-checked before any engagement. Bahamas Information Services: "The Bahamas Government Seeking to Advance Strategies to Take Advantage of the Benefits of AI"Official government (.gov.bs) 22 October 2025 Proposed / draft

Coordination with existing platforms would matter. The Tribune: "Minister: Bahamas ready for AI age"External reporting 10 June 2026 Reported, not independently confirmed

Professional evidence AVerified experience
